ruokakunnalle, jonka ainoalla tai kaikilla jäsenillä on oikeus 2 kohdassa tarkoitettuun eläkkeensaajan asumistukeen.

ruokakunnan asumismenojen alentumisesta vähintään 50 euroa kuukaudessa;

nodes.name: Report the change to Kela
nodes.description: Only the person who applied for the household reports the change, in OmaKela, on form AT 1, by phone or at a service point.

evidence.quote: Voit ilmoittaa muutoksista OmaKelassa. Jos et voi käyttää OmaKelaa, postita hakemus Kelaan.
Muutoksista voi ilmoittaa vain se henkilö, joka on hakenut asumistukea ruokakunnalle.
You can do it online in the OmaKela e-service, by phone or by visiting a Kela service point.

nodes.name: Detect a discrepancy or unreported change
nodes.description: Kela notices, without a report from the household, that circumstances differ from what the decision assumed or that allowance may have been paid wrongly.

evidence.quote: Jos et ilmoita muutoksista, sinulle voidaan maksaa liikaa tukea. Silloin joudumme perimään tukea myöhemmin takaisin.
Asumistuki voidaan tarkistaa ilman hakemusta, jos kaikki tarkistamisen perusteet ovat Kansaneläkelaitoksen käytettävissä.

nodes.inferred_reason: Sources imply Kela later discovers unreported changes (hence recovery) and may revise without an application, but do not say how detection happens.

nodes.name: Temporarily suspend or reduce payment
nodes.description: Payment may be suspended in whole or in part while Kela clarifies a reasonable suspicion that the recipient no longer has a right to the allowance.

evidence.quote: Asumistuen maksaminen voidaan väliaikaisesti keskeyttää osittain tai kokonaan, jos on perusteltua syytä olettaa, että asumistuen saajalla ei olosuhteiden muuttumisen vuoksi tai muusta syystä ole oikeutta tukeen tai osaan siitä.

nodes.name: Do the statutory grounds for revision or termination exist?
nodes.description: Kela tests the change against the revision grounds (income change, housing cost change of EUR 50, new home or tenure, household or subtenant change) and against grounds that end the right to allowance; a rise in housing costs alone does not reduce the allowance.

evidence.quote: Asumistukea on tarkistettava myös, jos:
ruokakunnan jatkuvat kuukausitulot ovat nousseet vähintään 400 euroa tai alentuneet vähintään 200 euroa;
Kela reviews the housing allowance as of 1 March, and the amount of housing allowance may change as a result of the review.

nodes.name: Retrieve updated income and household data for the review
nodes.description: Kela refreshes income and other data from the Incomes Register and its own records before recalculating, including for annual reviews and changes reported by the household.

evidence.quote: Kela can also get information on wages and salaries paid to you from the Incomes Register.
Asumistuki voidaan tarkistaa ilman hakemusta, jos kaikki tarkistamisen perusteet ovat Kansaneläkelaitoksen käytettävissä.

nodes.inferred_reason: Sources say the Incomes Register is used when processing applications and that reviews may use data Kela already holds; refreshing register data for reviews is implied rather than described.

nodes.name: Recalculate eligibility and allowance with the new data
nodes.description: Kela repeats the household, income, asset, cost and calculation steps with the changed or annual-review information.

evidence.quote: Kela will review your housing allowance at least every 12 months even if your household’s circumstances do not change.
Kela reviews the housing allowance as of 1 March, and the amount of housing allowance may change as a result of the review.

nodes.name: Outcome of the review: amount changes, unchanged or right ends
nodes.description: Kela decides whether the recalculation changes the amount, leaves it unchanged or shows that the household no longer has a right to the allowance.

sen kuukauden alusta, josta ruokakunnalla ei 8 §:n mukaan enää ole oikeutta asumistukeen;

nodes.inferred_reason: Sources state the possible outcomes of a review but not whether a person approves each revision or simple ones are automated.

nodes.name: Determine the date from which the revision takes effect
nodes.description: The revision applies from the start of the month in which changed housing costs or new circumstances apply for a full month, or from the month after an income change.

Ruokakunta saa asumistukea, ja asukkaiden lukumäärä muuttuu 25.5. Kela tarkistaa tuen 1.6. alkaen, ja asumistuen määrä voi muuttua.

nodes.name: Was allowance already paid wrongly for past months?
nodes.description: Kela checks whether the revised effective date means allowance paid for earlier months was paid without grounds or too high.

evidence.quote: Jos asumistukea on maksettu aiheetta tai määrältään liian suurena, liikaa maksettu tuki on perittävä takaisin.

nodes.name: Issue and deliver revised decision
nodes.description: Kela issues a written decision on the revised allowance (also used for rectification, error-correction and re-examination decisions) with appeal instructions, in OmaKela or by post.

evidence.quote: Asumistuen hakijalle annetaan kirjallinen päätös asumistuen myöntämisestä, hylkäämisestä, tarkistamisesta, lakkauttamisesta ja takaisinperinnästä.
You get instructions on how to appeal the decision with every decision notice you get from Kela.

nodes.name: Annual review cycle comes due
nodes.description: Allowance is reviewed at least every 12 months from its start or the previous review, with instructions going out about two months ahead.

evidence.quote: Asumistuen määrä tarkistetaan, kun tuen alkamisesta tai edellisestä tarkistamisesta on kulunut vuosi.
Tarkistamme asumistukesi määrän vähintään vuoden välein, vaikka ruokakuntasi olosuhteissa ei tapahtuisi muutoksia.

nodes.name: Send annual review instructions
nodes.description: About two months before the review date Kela sends instructions for the annual review as a message in OmaKela.

evidence.quote: Lähetämme sinulle ohjeet asumistuen vuositarkistusta varten noin 2 kuukautta ennen tarkistusta. Saat viestin OmaKelaan.
We will send you instructions about the annual review of your housing allowance about two months before the review is scheduled to take place. You will receive the message in OmaKela.

nodes.name: Submit information for the annual review
nodes.description: The recipient sends the information needed for the review on the allowance application in OmaKela, or by post if OmaKela cannot be used.

evidence.quote: Toimita meille vuositarkistuksessa tarvittavat tiedot OmaKelassa. Jos et voi käyttää OmaKelaa, postita hakemus Kelaan.
Send us the information needed for the annual review on the application for general housing allowance.
Annual review of the housing allowance because one year has passed since the housing allowance was awarded or last reviewed.

nodes.name: Was the review application received in time?
nodes.description: If the review application does not arrive before the review date, or information Kela asks for is not supplied in reasonable time, the allowance is stopped.

evidence.quote: Jos et tee hakemusta ajoissa ennen tarkistusajankohtaa, joudumme lakkauttamaan asumistukesi.

jos ruokakunta ei Kansaneläkelaitoksen kehotuksesta kohtuullisessa ajassa anna asumistuen tarkistamiseksi tarvittavia tietoja

nodes.name: Request termination of the allowance

evidence.quote: Jos et enää tarvitse asumistukea, ilmoita meille tuen lakkauttamisesta.
If you no longer need housing allowance, let us know that you want your housing allowance stopped.

nodes.name: Determine termination ground and end date
nodes.description: Kela establishes the ground and date from which the allowance ends: requested termination, move-out (from the month after the move), loss of entitlement or housing costs, missing review information, or a lone resident away more than 3 months.

Jos et ole asunnossasi yli 3 kuukauteen, oikeutesi asumistukeen päättyy.

nodes.name: Issue and deliver termination decision

evidence.quote: Asumistuen hakijalle annetaan kirjallinen päätös asumistuen myöntämisestä, hylkäämisestä, tarkistamisesta, lakkauttamisesta ja takaisinperinnästä.
You get instructions on how to appeal the decision with every decision notice you get from Kela.

nodes.name: Stop payment from the end date

evidence.quote: we will have to stop the payment of your housing allowance.
stop the payment of benefits.

nodes.name: Calculate the overpaid amount and period
nodes.description: Kela determines how much allowance was paid without grounds or too high and for which months; the Overpayment Recovery Centre handles recovery matters.

nodes.name: Is the payment within the 5-year recovery period?
nodes.description: A recovery decision must be made within five years of the payment date.

evidence.quote: Päätös aiheettomasti maksetun asumistuen takaisinperinnästä on tehtävä viiden vuoden kuluessa asumistuen maksupäivästä lukien.

nodes.name: Waive recovery in whole or in part?
nodes.description: Kela may waive recovery fully or partly if that is reasonable and the overpayment was not caused by the recipient's or representative's fraud, or if the amount is small.

evidence.quote: Takaisinperinnästä voidaan luopua joko kokonaan tai osittain, jos se katsotaan kohtuulliseksi eikä aiheeton maksaminen ole johtunut etuuden saajan tai hänen edustajansa vilpillisestä menettelystä

nodes.name: Determine who is liable to repay
nodes.description: Recovery goes first to the applicant and, if needed, to a spouse or other adult household member who committed to joint liability, and may also be directed at a landlord who received allowance without a right to it.

evidence.quote: Tuki peritään ensisijaisesti siltä henkilöltä, joka tuen on hakenut.

nodes.name: Issue appealable recovery decision to each liable person
nodes.description: Kela issues an appealable recovery decision to the applicant and a separate decision to each other person from whom the overpayment is recovered.

nodes.name: Offset the overpayment against later allowance or other benefit
nodes.description: The amount to be recovered can be offset against later allowance or comparable benefits; without the recipient's consent offsetting is limited to benefits under this law or comparable ones.

nodes.name: Repay the overpaid amount

nodes.name: Follow up repayment and enforce collection

nodes.name: Forward the appeal and Kela's statement to the Appeals Board

nodes.name: Social Security Appeals Board decides the appeal
nodes.description: The Social Security Appeals Board (sosiaaliturvan muutoksenhakulautakunta) hears the appeal, and may admit a late appeal if there is a weighty reason.

valitus voidaan ottaa tutkittavaksi, jos myöhästymiseen on ollut painava syy

nodes.name: Appeal the Board's decision to the Insurance Court

nodes.name: Insurance Court decides the appeal
nodes.description: The Insurance Court (vakuutusoikeus) decides; its decision cannot be appealed further.

evidence.quote: Vakuutusoikeuden päätökseen ei saa hakea muutosta valittamalla.

nodes.name: Implement the appeal ruling

nodes.inferred_reason: Not described in the sources; added because a ruling that changes a decision must be put into effect by Kela, as in general administrative practice.

nodes.name: Correct an erroneous decision (asiavirheen korjaaminen)
nodes.description: Kela may remove a decision based on clearly erroneous or incomplete evidence, manifestly wrong application of law or a procedural error and decide the matter again, to the party's benefit or detriment (detriment needs consent unless the error was the party's own doing).

evidence.quote: Kansaneläkelaitos voi poistaa virheellisen päätöksensä ja ratkaista asian uudelleen.

nodes.name: Re-examine a final decision on new evidence
nodes.description: When new evidence emerges in a matter of denied or insufficient allowance, Kela must re-examine it and may grant the denied allowance or a larger one despite the earlier final decision.

evidence.quote: Jos asiassa, jossa on kysymys evätyn asumistuen myöntämisestä tai myönnetyn asumistuen lisäämisestä, ilmenee uutta selvitystä, Kansaneläkelaitoksen on tutkittava asia uudelleen.

nodes.name: Application rejected or allowance not payable

evidence.quote: You will get a decision notice also if Kela rejects your application.

nodes.name: Allowance terminated

evidence.quote: Jos et tee hakemusta ajoissa ennen tarkistusajankohtaa, joudumme lakkauttamaan asumistukesi.
